status: FROZEN_PRE_FIRST_USE; SOURCE_CUSTODY_ONLY; NO TRAINING OR SCIENTIFIC DATA USE
research_line: Direct numeric weight-programming breadth, transfer, memory and real-world associations with independent strong controls
input_type: Wikidata real structured QID/PID/QID triples, no tokenized natural-language corpus

source.dataset: Wikidata5M transductive and inductive splits; derived from historical Wikidata, not live 2026
source.structured_data_license: CC0 1.0 Wikidata statements; excludes Wikipedia text and media
source.untrusted_mirror: Third-party published benchmark mirror; verify bytes/checksum and explicit provenance before admission.
source.cutoff_warning: Wikidata5M snapshot is historical (circa July 2019) and not a verified Nov 2026 fact database

source_custody.only_action: Read-only HTTPS archive fetch once, strict bounded bytes, compute SHA256 and enumerate compressed tar member names and uncompressed sizes. NEVER parse graph row values or run a model in this gate.
source_custody.network: Only public, no paid APIs, no authentication, no scheduling, no persistent service, ephemeral GitHub runner
source_custody.freeze_next: After successful custody, separately commit verified immutable source hash, exact member-path allowlist and split protocol before any source/truth read
source_custody.abort: Reject HTML, redirect to unapproved host, oversized archive, unsafe path, symlink/hardlink, duplicate member names, non-TAR compressed bytes, unexpected file types. Preserve 404/403/timeout as custody not scientific failure.

future_science_design.large_first: Prefer all 20,614,279 transductive train triples at full 822-relation breadth after provenance lock, and original disjoint heldout test; no first-use now.
future_science_design.fallback_selection: Deterministic source-record hashing stratified across relation IDs; recompute budgets, never choose a subset based on heldout outcomes; retain original negative
future_science_design.measures: Source fact recall with multisets; entity and relation heldout generalization; verified two-hop composition; contradictory version changes; uncertainty-calibrated abstention; cold retention and interference; total cost/CPU/memory/actions; data licensing/custody
future_science_design.leakage: Do not touch published validation or test triples while source preprocessing and train split is frozen; do not use Wikipedia text as CC0 or train on the answers
future_science_design.independent_controls: Exact symbolic graph lookup and path-query baseline, a fully trained conventional knowledge-graph representation model with matched data/time, negative randomly programmed weights and disjoint relation controls
future_science_design.success: Independent improvement with equal evidence/actions/whole-process cost, multi-seed replication and held-out domains; ingestion success, storing facts or a rulebook do not prove AGI or scientific superiority
